tldr: The Moon in Leo: emotions need warmth, recognition, and creative expression.
body: With the Moon in Leo, feelings want to be honored, not dismissed. Emotional safety grows when joy, play, affection, and appreciation are allowed to take up space.
gift: Generosity, passion, loyalty, and the ability to make emotional life expressive and alive.
challenge: Dramatizing pain, needing applause, or turning vulnerability into performance.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
